public_vs_admin_flight_overrides.sourceExplanation: Source inspection confirms src/routes/{-$locale}.admin.flights.index.tsx invokes withOverride() from useAdmin() (reading localStorage['gza.admin.v1']), whereas src/routes/{-$locale}.flights.tsx reads raw static flight entries from src/lib/data.ts without calling withOverride().

public_vs_admin_bookings.description: Public bookings from /book write to localStorage['gza.store.v1'] via useStore(). Admin bookings at /admin/bookings read hardcoded mockBookings in src/lib/admin-mock.ts.
public_vs_admin_bookings.nature: Architectural inference based on source inspection: no public booking was created in this run, but source inspection confirms public store (src/lib/store.tsx) and admin mockBookings (src/lib/admin-mock.ts) operate in completely decoupled storage layers with no cross-store synchronization.
